# Bumi-MCP — Full Reference

FastMCP 3.4+ server for Noetix Bumi humanoid — hero specs, OSS links, fleet virtual-twin guidance, optional robot bridge.

## Ports
| Service | Port |
|---------|------|
| Backend (FastAPI + MCP /mcp) | 10774 |
| Frontend (Vite React) | 10775 |

## MCP Tools
- `bumi_specs` — Hero robot specifications and capabilities
- `bumi_links` — OSS and reference links
- `bumi_guidance` — Virtual-twin guidance and mission planning
- `bumi_bridge` — Optional physical robot bridge commands

## Configuration
| Variable | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| `MCP_TRANSPORT` | Transport mode |
| `BUMI_BRIDGE_ENABLED` | Enable physical robot bridge |
